description: The feature's plan.md and a code file, textstats/counts.py, are both uncommitted. Code outside the feature's folder blocks the run: a one-line stop that names only the code file, with no spec commit and no branch switch.

must_match.pattern: ^Uncommitted changes in textstats/counts\.py\. Commit or stash them, then run implement-task again\.\s*\Z
must_match.why: the exact stop line names only the code file and is the last line

must_not_match.why: the user's change is left alone
the spec file is not named as blocking in the stop line
the branch is not switched before the stop
